summary.headline: Nativity with Aries Ascending
summary.text: An astrological example of a nativity with Aries ascending, listing the Sun and Mercury in Aquarius, Moon in Sagittarius, Saturn and Mars in Scorpio, Jupiter in Cancer, and Venus in Capricorn. The native’s fortune is judged through the Sun’s triplicity lords: Saturn first and Mercury second, both in succedent angles, with Saturn in the western succedent angle.
